decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith )Photo Montage, Design and Access Statement, Drawing Numbers A461 MO3, A461 M02, A461 M01, A461 02, A461 01, received 15/03/10.A461 O3B received 26/05/10.) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Fridays and 9am-1pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a rear infill conservatory extension, a partial side and rear extension to link house to existing outbuilding, addition of pitched roof to outbuilding, conversion of existing outbuilding into habitable space, second floor rear dormer extension and internal and external alterations and refurbishments, including re-roofing with Rosemary Red clay tiles; repair, cleaning and re-pointing brickwork as required, repair and replacement of joinery to match original as required with double glazed windows in new extensions. (Planning and Listed Building Consent)
